aggregation: Each seed metric is computed from all eligible nets in its scope, then three seed metrics are equally averaged; P95 is not a quantile of seed-averaged per-net scores.

confidence_intervals.coupled_models: Same family draw for every method and seed; seed metrics averaged inside each replicate.
confidence_intervals.coupled_variants: All physical implementations of one logical family share their bootstrap multiplicity.
confidence_intervals.point_weighting: Net-weighted mean and equal-design macro mean retain their declared weights within resampled families.
confidence_intervals.single_family: A scope with one family produces a degenerate empirical interval, not informative distributional uncertainty.
confidence_intervals.training_seeds: Fixed fitted models; training seeds are not treated as independent design clusters.

metric_scale: dimensionless relative regret; multiply by 100 for percent
